name: DOMPurify
shortDescription: Fast, well-audited library for sanitizing HTML and SVG against XSS attacks.
useCases: Sanitizing user-generated HTML/markdown output to prevent XSS
Rendering rich text safely in SPAs/SSR without trusting input
Enforcing allowlists for attributes, tags, and URL protocols
description: A fast, well-audited library to sanitize HTML and SVG against XSS attacks in browsers and Node.js.
We run DOMPurify at render time or on ingestion to neutralize scripts, event handlers, and dangerous URLs—paired with strict CSP and escaping for defense-in-depth.
